title: Question 28
passage:
Who can water the window plants while you’re away?
A. They’re on the kitchen windowsill. B. I’ll be away for four days. C. My neighbor has offered to do it.
passageZh:
你不在的時候，誰能幫窗邊的植物澆水？
A. 它們在廚房的窗台上。 B. 我會離開四天。 C. 我鄰居已主動說可以幫忙。
